title: API design
description: Design a data model and matching API contract, review compatibility and invariants, and request operator sign-off.

task.title: Draft the data model
task.instructions:
Use data-model-design. Register a data-model with identifiers, relations, lifecycle, constraints, access patterns and examples of invalid transitions.

Agreed brief:
{{inputs.brief}}
Write operator-facing text in the operator's language.
acceptance: Model invariants and migration assumptions are explicit.

task.title: Draft the API contract
task.instructions:
Use api-contract-design. Register an api-contract with operations, request and response examples, validation, access control, errors, versioning and idempotency where needed. Map the contract to the reviewed data model. This is draft round {{loop.iteration}}. On revision, find the API contract review note for run {{run.id}} in project knowledge; do not treat missing evidence as clearance.

Agreed brief:
{{inputs.brief}}
Write operator-facing text in the operator's language.
acceptance: Operations and types agree with the model; intentional differences are explained.

nodes.title: Review the contract and model together

task.title: Review the contract and model together
task.instructions:
Use architecture-review and workflow-verdict. Cross-check identifiers, optionality, state transitions, failure behavior and compatibility between the API and data model. Register a adr note titled API contract review {{run.id}} round {{loop.iteration}}, and return pass or fail with notes. Block if a model change is required rather than accepting an inconsistent contract.
Write operator-facing text in the operator's language.
acceptance: Pass only when consumers can implement against both artifacts without contradictory assumptions.

nodes.title: Operator sign-off
nodes.prompt:
Sign off on the reviewed API contract and data model, including compatibility and migration assumptions. No code is changed by this workflow.

Review notes: {{nodes.review.output.notes}}

nodes.title: Review did not pass within two drafts
Stopped: Review the contract and model together
